name: TurantMart
tagline: Ten-minute grocery delivery where Diwali evening is everyone's emergency
summary: TurantMart delivers groceries in ten minutes from 400 dark stores: app, catalogue, search, cart, offers, payments, orders, store picking, riders and notifications. Diwali evening brings ten times a normal peak, a rainy night doubles orders while riders vanish, and limited drops attract scripts. Offers that expire all at once, inventory syncs that choke the database and UPI failures keep coming back.

debts.title: Precompute the next campaign's offers and switch without flushing the cache
debts.desc: Build the next campaign's offers into a new cache version ahead of time and switch to it atomically.
debts.cause: A campaign switch flushes the whole offer cache

debts.title: Delta inventory sync through a queue
debts.desc: Send only stock changes from each store, through a queue, spread over the minute.
debts.cause: Every store syncs its full inventory at once

debts.title: Fail over UPI to a second provider automatically
debts.desc: Route UPI through two providers behind a circuit breaker and switch when one's success rate drops.
debts.cause: UPI runs through a single provider with no automatic switch

debts.title: Assign riders in bulk: one round trip per store every 10 seconds
debts.desc: Assign riders to all of a store's waiting orders in one batch every 10 seconds instead of one order at a time.
debts.cause: Riders are assigned one order at a time

debts.title: Rate limits per account and device on limited drops
debts.desc: One unit per account and device for limited drops, with a queue and a CAPTCHA.
debts.cause: Limited drops have no per-account limit or device check

debts.title: Regression tests and a staged rollout for app releases
debts.desc: Run regression tests on every release, release to 5% of users first and stop the rollout automatically if crashes rise.
debts.cause: App releases go to every user at once with no staged rollout

debts.title: Push order updates to the app as notifications instead of polling
debts.desc: Send order changes to the app as push notifications through a message queue, and let it poll at most every 30 seconds.
debts.cause: Apps poll order status instead of receiving pushed updates

debts.title: Separate connection pools for orders and analytics jobs
debts.desc: Give orders and checkout their own pool; run analytics on a replica.
debts.cause: Orders and analytics jobs share one connection pool

debts.title: Precompute store stock per product and serve it cached for 5 seconds
debts.desc: Serve catalogue stock from a short-lived cache updated by the delta sync.

debts.title: Load test Diwali evening at 10x
debts.desc: Rehearse ten times the normal evening peak before every festival.

debts.title: Index search by store and availability
debts.desc: Add a store-and-availability index for product search.

debts.title: Idempotency key per checkout
debts.desc: Make a retried checkout safe so it never charges twice.

debts.title: Use IST for offer validity windows
